Name: Lone Corner Farm
Author: windvalley
Description:
[b]Overview[/b]

This is a new farm type that has roughly the same space for farming as the top right corner of the four corners farm. There are config options that modify the properties, starting gifts and layout to match the other starting farms (Forest, Riverlands, Hilltop and Meadowlands). 

[b]Features

[/b][list]
[*]New farm type, does not replace any vanilla farms
[*]Small area, more challenging but less overwhelming than a full-size vanilla farm
[*]Config Options that modify the layout, starting gift and properties to match various vanilla farms (Forest, Riverlands, Hilltop and Meadowlands)
[/list]
[list]
[*]Custom starter farmhouse layout
[/list][list]
[/list]
[b]Config
[/b]
[list]
[*]Standard (default): Starting gift of 15 parsnip seeds, no special properties
[*]Foraging: Starting gift of 15 parsnip seeds, 3 respawning hardwood stumps south of the greenhouse, and forage like the vanilla forest farm
[*]Fishing: Starting gift of 15 parsnip seeds and a fish smoker, modified catch pool to match the vanilla riverlands farm: 70% chance of catching town river fish and 30% chance of catching forest fish off the southern dock
[*]Mining: Starting gift of 15 parsnip seeds, respawning ore, stone and geode nodes like the vanilla hilltop farm south of the greenhouse
[/list]
[list]
[*]Ranching: Starting gift of 15 hay OR 15 Chicken feed if the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26443]Poultry Diet Rework[/url]﻿ mod is installed, Starts with blue grass growing in the field, Coop with 1 white and 1 brown chick if [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]spacecore[/url]﻿ is installed
[/list]
[b]Installation
 
[/b]Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]Smapi[/url]﻿, and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]content patcher[/url]﻿. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]Spacecore[/url]﻿ is required for the coop to appear in the ranching config option. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] is recommended to more easily change the farm type  
Download and then extract into your Stardew Valley mods folder.
[b]
Mods Pictured
[/b]
[list]

[/list][list]

[/list]
